events.title: Strait of Hormuz CLOSED Day 161 - Iran-Oman deal pending, US blockade continues
events.source: iransitrep.com, Fortune, CBS, Fox News, Al Jazeera, Wikipedia
events.summary: Hormuz effectively closed Day 161. Iran-Oman shipping corridor agreement being drafted but not finalized. US blockade of Iranian ports continues. CENTCOM strikes resumed after July ceasefire collapse. Iran parliament bill to ban US/Israeli vessels. Houthi warnings to Bahrain/UAE. Brent ~$82/bbl. Gold at $4,350 safe haven.
events.status_change: Evolving - Iran-Oman corridor deal pending, US blockade holds, no ceasefire

events.title: US-Japan joint yen intervention $58.97B - KRW surges 8.8% carry trade unwind
events.source: CNBC, Reuters, Chosun, FXStreet, Fortune, JP Morgan
events.summary: Joint US-Japan FX intervention Aug 1-3. $58.97B deployed. Yen 163->157->158. KRW surged 8.8% fastest since 2008 - carry trade unwind signal. BOJ left rates at 1%, Ueda hawkish. BOA sees yen at 149 by end-2026. 2Y JGB 1.545% highest since 1995.
events.status_change: Stabilizing but carry trade unwind risk elevated - KRW surge confirms

events.title: Ebola PHEIC accelerating - 3,973 cases 1,801 deaths WHO unprecedented rate
events.source: WHO, ECDC, CDC, UN News, Al Jazeera, Wikipedia
events.summary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola. PHEIC declared May 16. 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths (up to Aug 4). 674 hospitalized. 300+ children dead. WHO: spreading at unprecedented rate. CDC responding. Vaccine trials starting. Cases in DRC and Uganda (2 deaths).
events.status_change: Worsening - WHO chief says unprecedented rate, 300+ children dead, vaccine trials urged

events.title: Sudan RSF siege of El-Obeid + Nigeria-South Africa xenophobic crisis
events.source: NPR, DW, Sudan Tribune, BBC, allAfrica, Rio Times
events.summary: Sudan: 500K trapped in El-Obeid, drone strikes, cholera, water shortages, UN warns imminent mass atrocities. Nigeria-South Africa: diplomatic crisis, 109K deportations, Ghana cancelled Ramaphosa visit. Nigeria security forces struggling with multiple threats.
events.status_change: Worsening - Sudan siege continues, Nigeria-SA crisis deepening with diplomatic fallout

events.title: Europe energy grid stress + ECB rate hold + German bund yields above 3%
events.source: ECB, Trading Economics, House of Commons Library
events.summary: ECB held rates at 2.25%, cut 8 times Jun24-Jun25 then paused. DE10Y above 3.0% (AMBER). Paks nuclear outage, Danube historic lows, diesel margins 20yr highs. Hungary near energy crisis. UK gilts volatile, 24B Treasury gap, BoE 6-3 hold.
events.status_change: Ongoing - heatwave persisting, fiscal stress mounting

events.title: Fed: 3 FOMC dissenters vote for hike, Warsh hawkish, Treasury refunding Aug 15
events.source: JP Morgan, NYT, Reuters, CME FedWatch
events.summary: July FOMC held at 3.5-3.75%. 3 members wanted hike (unusual). Warsh hawkish on inflation. Markets pricing hike odds up. Bond yields rising. $125B Treasury refunding Aug 15. No emergency action but trajectory hawkish.
events.status_change: Elevated - 3 dissenters signal tightening bias, hike odds rising

events.title: Korean Won surges 8.8% - joint US-Japan-Korea intervention, carry trade unwind
events.source: Chosun, KED Global, FXStreet, JP Morgan
events.summary: KRW surged 8.8% fastest since 2008. Won at 9-month high ~1415. Joint US-Japan-Korea FX intervention. Individuals buying dollars. Carry trade unwind risk. KRW best performing Asian currency on semiconductor demand + intervention.
events.status_change: Stabilizing - won strengthening but carry trade unwind risk persists

events.title: Gold at $4,350 record safe haven - oil declining on Hormuz deal hopes
events.summary: Gold at $4,350/oz (+2.61% Aug 7), up 28% YoY. Safe haven flows from Iran war + rate hike fears. Brent declining to ~$82 on Hormuz reopening hopes. Gold-oil inverse correlation persisting. Gold record high was $5,602 in Jan 2026.
events.status_change: Elevated - gold safe haven flows intensifying, oil declining on peace hopes

events.title: Argentina-Brazil diplomatic crisis - ambassador withdrawn, IMF payments looming
events.source: PIIE, Buenos Aires Herald, Rio Times
events.summary: Brazil withdrew ambassador from Argentina. Diplomatic crisis threatens trade relationship. Argentina Merval -2.61%. IMF payments $3B due H2 2026, doubling in 2027. Colombia BanRep minutes under pressure.

events.title: China PBOC loose policy H2 2026 - property bust spilling, currency undervalued 20%
events.source: CFR, Business Recorder, Beijing Review, CEIC
events.summary: PBOC pledges moderately loose monetary policy H2 2026. Property bust spilling across borders. Current account surplus shifting 4pp. Currency undervalued 20%+ per CFR. 3M bond yield 1.174%. Panda bond issuance facilitation.
events.status_change: Ongoing - PBOC maintaining loose stance, structural pressures persist

events.title: UK gilt volatility + 24B Treasury gap + BoE 6-3 hold + mortgage rates rising
events.source: Trading Economics, WCG, HomeOwners Alliance, BBC
events.summary: BoE 6-3 hold at 3.75%. Gilts volatile on 24B Treasury gap. New government policy pledges require debt issuance. Mortgage rates edging back up in August. Geopolitical risks from Tehran increasing.
events.status_change: Elevated - fiscal uncertainty, mortgage rates rising

events.title: Russia bankruptcies +13.7% YoY + US regulatory oversight gap systemic risk
events.summary: Russian bankruptcies up 13.7% YoY, record 636K declarations. Wartime debt boom banking crisis risk. US: federal regulatory bodies face workforce reductions, oversight gap threatens systemic stability. Private market discipline must substitute for federal supervision.
events.status_change: Elevated - Russian banking stress + US deregulatory gap
